recipes.label: Hiring flow gap
recipes.definition: 28-day percentage growth in new postings minus 28-day percentage growth in all postings. Positive means fresh hiring intent is growing faster than the outstanding pool. It does not measure vacancies filled.

method: Expanding-window OLS: target annual growth at fixed one-, two- and three-month horizons, using signal annual growth and current target growth. Minimum 36 training observations; labels must end before test inputs. Baseline is an autoregression fitted on the same training rows, using only current target growth. At least 12 test months required. Positive skill means lower RMSE than that matched autoregressive baseline. All specified pairs and horizons retained, including unsuccessful results. No specification is selected for the country assessments.
limitation: Evaluation uses revised observation history. Release timing, parameter selection, transaction costs and asset returns are outside the model specification.
